# All Cleanz

> All Cleanz is a professional domestic and commercial cleaning company based in Prescot, Merseyside, UK, working across the North West of England. It offers a wide range of cleaning services for homes, offices and commercial properties, on a regular (daily, weekly or monthly) or one off basis.

Key facts:

- Location: based in Prescot, Merseyside, serving Merseyside and the North West
- Phone and WhatsApp: 07721 938429 (+44 7721 938429)
- Email: enquiries@allcleanznorthwest.co.uk
- Carpet, upholstery and hard floor cleaning uses the patented Texatherm® process (https://www.texatherm.com/). Textiles dry in 30 minutes, guaranteed.
- Quality control includes on-site inspections and customer surveys.
- Clients include Eccleston Park Lawn Tennis Club and King George V Sports Complex.
- Rated 4.9 out of 5 on Google: https://share.google/Gg61WBgD1EcMRRVPn

## Services

- End of Tenancy Cleaning
- Deep Cleaning
- Domestic Cleaning
- Carpet & Upholstery Cleaning (Texatherm®, 30 minute drying)
- Office Cleaning
- After Build Cleaning
- Pre & Post Party Cleaning
- Oven Cleaning
- Fridge Cleaning
- Window Cleaning
- Car Valeting
- Jet Washing
- Gutter Cleaning
- BBQ Cleaning
